"Which of the following is the graph of $y=-\frac{2}{x-1}?$" :question/worked-solution "To plot $y=-\frac{2}{x-1},$ we apply the following steps:

- Take the curve $y=-\frac{1}{x}.$

![](images/f9/f991da5a7c524fd08efcdb83713f1f6e8cee69165a5f80bb15446649bee7dc92.png)

- Translate it by $1$ unit to the right to get the graph of $y=-\frac{1}{x-1}.$

![](images/fb/fb962040e597072461a056b7578fb87d03fd86d7634ab16443de150f309791f6.png)

- Then, stretch the result by a scale factor of $2$ parallel to the $y$-axis to get the graph of $y=-\frac{2}{x-1}.$
